## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `reader-writer-contract-change-salience`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-08-08T08:04:42.076Z.

Context relevance ledger (31): the cheapest high-value context signal available today is the set of contracts whose reader and writer were last edited in different changes.

Recorded 2026-08-08. Extends the ledger; entries 1 through 30 stand.

Why this belongs to relevance and not only to CI. The engine ranks what an agent should look at next. Today's incident says one class of item is systematically underranked: the item that is fine in isolation and broken only in relation to another item that changed. The release gate was correct. The exception reporter was correct. The pair was not, and no signal in the corpus expresses pairness, so nothing could have surfaced it before it halted the pipeline.

The signal, concretely. For any declared contract that one side resolves against a catalog, compute the interval between the last change to the reader and the last change to the writer, and the presence or absence of a test that exercises both in one process. A reader rebound to a stricter contract with no co-edited writer and no joint test is the highest-risk shape in the corpus, and it is derivable entirely from data already recorded: linked files per item, commit adjacency, and the generated catalog membership that both sides already reference. It needs no new instrumentation.

Why it ranks well. It is sparse, which matters under a token budget — most contracts have co-edited sides and drop out. It is temporal, so it decays correctly as parity is established. And it is explainable in one sentence, which the ranking surface requires: this reader got stricter on a date, its writer did not change, and nothing tests them together.

Relation to prior entries. Entry 30 established that the deepest enforceable claim over the edge record is a degree floor, because the graph has one automated reader. This entry is the same shortage seen from the ranking side: the corpus is rich in relations that no scorer consumes, and the pairing relation is the one with a demonstrated cost attached. Recurrence, which pm-ouyq3n owns, is the other half — a defect family fixed thirty times is thirty unrelated nodes, and a contract broken at its seam is two healthy nodes. Both are invisible for the same reason, that relevance is currently computed per node.

Caution against overfitting. This is one observation, not a fitted weight. The honest disposition is a candidate in the portfolio registry pm-g8t7b9 owns, scored against the judgment corpus before it is given any coefficient, and explicitly not promoted on the strength of the incident that suggested it.

Scope clarification from individual-ownership review: pm-ouyq3n owns a related measurement, read primitive or defect fix. It does not independently deliver this proposed ranking behavior. Reuse its evidence and public API; evaluate the additional behavior in this experiment.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
